messages:
alice: deploy-bot just blocked the staging -> prod promotion for v2.14.0, provenance checksum mismatch on eu-ecr. holding the release.

deploy-bot: :warning: publish blocked: provenance-check FAILED for image redwood/runtime:v2.14.0 (sha256:abc123... vs expected sha256:abf999...). See logs below.
```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z ERROR provenance: manifest digest mismatch (calculated=sha256:abc123..., registry=sha256:abf999...)
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z INFO uploader: chunk upload complete
2026-03-20T18:12:04Z INFO retry: revalidate attestation
```

ben: ugh, that one slipped through staging smoke? did canary show anything?

eve: canary was green on basic flows, but we didn't run full provenance lint in that pipeline (we only run in gating for staging -> prod).

carol: which registry/region? I can check replication lag or eventual consistency issues.

alice: eu-ecr (eu-west-1). Deploybot indicates the registry returned a different manifest digest than the attested build metadata. could be mirror lag or an attestation mismatch. we should not release until we confirm.

dave: oncall here — if it's just a mirror mismatch we can wait a bit, but if the buildid differs we need to retag and republish. what's the root build id for that image?

ben: build metadata: build_id=202603201712, cosign-sig=present, attestation: sbom+buildinfo attached.

deploy-bot: attestation summary:
- build_id: 202603201712
- manifest_digest_attested: sha256:abf999...
- registry_manifest_digest: sha256:abc123...
- cosign_key_id: projects/redwood/keys/kms-prod-01

carol: registry digest (sha256:abc123...) corresponds to layer ordering we saw on a previous retry. suspect a multipart push raced with a mirror redirect. eu-ecr reported success but the attestation was generated against the original upload which got rewritten.

alice: options: 1) wait 15-30m to see if replica converges AND re-run provenance check, 2) retag+re-publish the exact build (rebake?) or 3) roll back the promotion and create a -rc tag for manual canary after QA runs. I vote retag+republish with pinned digest to avoid flakiness.

ben: +1 retag & republish. we should also bump release notes to explain a retag and include audit link.

eve: QA will run full provenance lint & smoke on the republished image if you tag it as v2.14.0-rc1. ping me when done.

carol: I can do the retag/push. plan:
1) pull attested image layers from eu-ecr replica (verify checksum locally)
2) re-push to eu-ecr under tag v2.14.0-rc1 with explicit manifest digest pinned
3) attach attestation again using same cosign key
4) update deploybot canary route to point to v2.14.0-rc1

alice: sounds good. please add an incident note in the release thread and update release-notes.md with a short line: "retagged v2.14.0 -> v2.14.0-rc1 due to provenance manifest mismatch; will monitor canary"

carol: starting step 1 now. will post progress.

deploy-bot: action queued: manual_republish_request by carol for redwood/runtime build 202603201712.

carol: pulled layers & verified checksums locally, found layer 4 reordering; repushing manifest with canonical ordering now.

carol: pushed v2.14.0-rc1 -> new digest sha256:abg555... attaching attestation.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish complete. attestation attached, manifest digest=sha256:abg555...

eve: QA starting full provenance lint + smoke tests on v2.14.0-rc1 canary.

dave: oncall acked. if QA green, we'll promote to prod with a manual rollout and keep old tag pinned for 2 hours in case we need to roll back.

alice: decision: hold original v2.14.0 tag (do not promote). promote v2.14.0-rc1 to canary. if QA passes in 45m, proceed with gradual rollout and rotate release notes to mention republish event. notify support + sales of minor release window.

ben: noted. I'll update the release checklist and add a short blurb in the changelog under "release-process notes".

carol: done. closing the hold. will monitor ECR replication for 1h and follow up if anything else shows up.

alice: thanks everyone. logging this thread into the release audit. :thumbsup:
